name: plasterboard (drywall)
definition: gypsum core board in paper liners, fixed to studs or joists to line walls and ceilings; wallboard, baseboard, moisture and fire boards are types.
notes: Wickes lists Plasterboard as its own subcategory under Plaster & Plasterboard, apart from Sheet Materials

name: MDF sheet
definition: medium-density fibreboard sheet with a smooth even face, for joinery, shelving and painting; standard, moisture-resistant and flexible are types.
notes: Wickes sells MDF Sheets as its own category (general purpose, beaded, flexible)

name: chipboard sheet
definition: particle board of wood chips and resin sold as flooring boards, loft panels and sheets; P5 tongue-and-groove flooring is the common type.
notes: Wickes sells Chipboard Sheets and Chipboard Flooring as their own categories

name: OSB sheet
definition: oriented strand board, load-bearing sheet of layered wood strands for flooring, roofing, sheathing and temporary boarding (OSB 3 is the usual grade).
notes: Wickes sells OSB as its own subcategory of Sheet Materials
